targets.queryText: SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM rel_domain.release_domain WHERE score >= 0.5
SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM rel_subnet.release_subnet WHERE score >= 0.5
SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM rel_host.release_host WHERE score >= 0.5
SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM rel_text.release_text WHERE score >= 0.5
SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM rel_image.release_image WHERE score >= 0.5
SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM rel_content_template.release_content_template WHERE score >= 0.5

panels.description: Latest release_history entry

targets.queryText: SELECT MAX(released_at)::TIMESTAMPTZ AS time FROM (SELECT released_at FROM rel_domain.release_history UNION ALL SELECT released_at FROM rel_subnet.release_history UNION ALL SELECT released_at FROM rel_host.release_history UNION ALL SELECT released_at FROM rel_text.release_history UNION ALL SELECT released_at FROM rel_image.release_history UNION ALL SELECT released_at FROM rel_content_template.release_history)

panels.title: Last Inference

panels.description: Most recent model training (newest .lgb file mtime)

targets.queryText: SELECT MAX(trained_at) AS time FROM model_info

panels.title: Last Retrained

panels.description: On-list count over time per entity type

targets.queryText: SELECT t AS time, MAX(CASE WHEN et = 'domain' THEN c END) AS "Domains", MAX(CASE WHEN et = 'subnet' THEN c END) AS "Subnets", MAX(CASE WHEN et = 'host' THEN c END) AS "Hosts", MAX(CASE WHEN et = 'text' THEN c END) AS "Text", MAX(CASE WHEN et = 'image' THEN c END) AS "Images", MAX(CASE WHEN et = 'template' THEN c END) AS "Templates" FROM (SELECT DATE_TRUNC('hour', released_at)::TIMESTAMPTZ AS t, 'domain' AS et, on_list_count AS c FROM rel_domain.release_history UNION ALL SELECT DATE_TRUNC('hour', released_at)::TIMESTAMPTZ, 'subnet', on_list_count FROM rel_subnet.release_history UNION ALL SELECT DATE_TRUNC('hour', released_at)::TIMESTAMPTZ, 'host', on_list_count FROM rel_host.release_history UNION ALL SELECT DATE_TRUNC('hour', released_at)::TIMESTAMPTZ, 'text', on_list_count FROM rel_text.release_history UNION ALL SELECT DATE_TRUNC('hour', released_at)::TIMESTAMPTZ, 'image', on_list_count FROM rel_image.release_history UNION ALL SELECT DATE_TRUNC('hour', released_at)::TIMESTAMPTZ, 'template', on_list_count FROM rel_content_template.release_history) GROUP BY t ORDER BY t

panels.title: Entities on List

panels.description: New spam and cleared entities per release

targets.queryText: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('hour', released_at)::TIMESTAMPTZ AS time, CAST(SUM(new_spam) AS INTEGER) AS "New Spam", CAST(SUM(cleared) AS INTEGER) AS "Cleared" FROM (SELECT released_at, new_spam, cleared FROM rel_domain.release_history UNION ALL SELECT released_at, new_spam, cleared FROM rel_subnet.release_history UNION ALL SELECT released_at, new_spam, cleared FROM rel_host.release_history UNION ALL SELECT released_at, new_spam, cleared FROM rel_text.release_history UNION ALL SELECT released_at, new_spam, cleared FROM rel_image.release_history UNION ALL SELECT released_at, new_spam, cleared FROM rel_content_template.release_history) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: List Churn (New Spam / Cleared)

panels.description: Recent releases across all entity types

targets.queryText: SELECT STRFTIME(released_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%M') AS released_at, entity_type, total_scored, released_spam_count, new_spam, cleared FROM (SELECT released_at, 'domain' AS entity_type, total_scored, on_list_count AS released_spam_count, new_spam, cleared FROM rel_domain.release_history UNION ALL SELECT released_at, 'subnet', total_scored, on_list_count, new_spam, cleared FROM rel_subnet.release_history UNION ALL SELECT released_at, 'host', total_scored, on_list_count, new_spam, cleared FROM rel_host.release_history UNION ALL SELECT released_at, 'text', total_scored, on_list_count, new_spam, cleared FROM rel_text.release_history UNION ALL SELECT released_at, 'image', total_scored, on_list_count, new_spam, cleared FROM rel_image.release_history UNION ALL SELECT released_at, 'template', total_scored, on_list_count, new_spam, cleared FROM rel_content_template.release_history) ORDER BY released_at DESC LIMIT 30

panels.title: Release History

panels.description: Spam score bucket counts per entity type

targets.queryText: SELECT entity_type, CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN score >= 0.9 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS INTEGER) AS "0.9 to 1.0", CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN score >= 0.7 AND score < 0.9 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS INTEGER) AS "0.7 to 0.9", CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN score >= 0.5 AND score < 0.7 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS INTEGER) AS "0.5 to 0.7", CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN score >= 0.0 AND score < 0.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS INTEGER) AS "0.0 to 0.5", CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN score >= -0.3 AND score < 0.0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS INTEGER) AS "-0.3 to 0.0", CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN score < -0.3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS INTEGER) AS "-1.0 to -0.3" FROM (SELECT 'domain' AS entity_type, score FROM rel_domain.release_domain UNION ALL SELECT 'subnet', score FROM rel_subnet.release_subnet UNION ALL SELECT 'host', score FROM rel_host.release_host UNION ALL SELECT 'text', score FROM rel_text.release_text UNION ALL SELECT 'image', score FROM rel_image.release_image UNION ALL SELECT 'template', score FROM rel_content_template.release_content_template) GROUP BY entity_type ORDER BY entity_type

panels.title: Score Distribution (All Entities)

panels.description: Domains with spam_score >= 0.5, sorted by score

targets.queryText: SELECT r.key AS domain, ROUND(r.score, 4) AS spam_score, ROUND(d.header_mailfrom_ratio, 2) AS hdr_mf_ratio, r.traffic, ROUND(r.traffic_spam_ratio, 3) AS traffic_spam_ratio, STRFTIME(r.first_flagged_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%M') AS flagged_at FROM rel_domain.release_domain r LEFT JOIN domain d ON d.domain = r.key WHERE r.score >= 0.5 ORDER BY r.score DESC LIMIT 50

panels.title: Spam Domains

targets.queryText: SELECT r.key AS subnet, ROUND(r.score, 4) AS spam_score, r.traffic, ROUND(r.traffic_spam_ratio, 3) AS traffic_spam_ratio, STRFTIME(r.first_flagged_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%M') AS flagged_at FROM rel_subnet.release_subnet r WHERE r.score >= 0.5 ORDER BY r.score DESC LIMIT 50

SELECT r.key AS host, ROUND(r.score, 4) AS spam_score, r.traffic, ROUND(r.traffic_spam_ratio, 3) AS traffic_spam_ratio, STRFTIME(r.first_flagged_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%M') AS flagged_at FROM rel_host.release_host r WHERE r.score >= 0.5 ORDER BY r.score DESC LIMIT 50

panels.description: Text content hashes on the ML spam list

targets.queryText: SELECT r.key AS text_hash, ROUND(r.score, 4) AS spam_score, r.traffic, ROUND(r.traffic_spam_ratio, 3) AS traffic_spam_ratio FROM rel_text.release_text r WHERE r.score >= 0.5 ORDER BY r.score DESC LIMIT 50

panels.title: Spam Text

panels.description: Image content hashes on the ML spam list

targets.queryText: SELECT r.key AS image_hash, ROUND(r.score, 4) AS spam_score, r.traffic, ROUND(r.traffic_spam_ratio, 3) AS traffic_spam_ratio FROM rel_image.release_image r WHERE r.score >= 0.5 ORDER BY r.score DESC LIMIT 50

panels.title: Spam Images

panels.description: HTML template hashes on the ML spam list

targets.queryText: SELECT r.key AS template_hash, ROUND(r.score, 4) AS spam_score, r.traffic, ROUND(r.traffic_spam_ratio, 3) AS traffic_spam_ratio FROM rel_content_template.release_content_template r WHERE r.score >= 0.5 ORDER BY r.score DESC LIMIT 50

panels.title: Spam Templates

panels.description: ML-flagged domains unknown to FortiGuard

targets.queryText: SELECT r.key AS domain, ROUND(r.score, 4) AS spam_score, r.traffic, ROUND(r.traffic_spam_ratio, 3) AS traffic_spam_ratio, STRFTIME(r.first_flagged_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%M') AS flagged_at FROM rel_domain.release_domain r LEFT JOIN domain d ON d.domain = r.key WHERE r.score >= 0.5 AND NOT r.has_fg_score AND r.traffic >= 20 ORDER BY r.traffic DESC LIMIT 30

panels.title: ML-Only High-Traffic Domains (no FG score)

panels.description: Domains recently added to the spam list

targets.queryText: SELECT r.key AS domain, ROUND(r.score, 4) AS spam_score, r.traffic, ROUND(r.traffic_spam_ratio, 3) AS traffic_spam_ratio, STRFTIME(r.first_flagged_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%M') AS flagged_at FROM rel_domain.release_domain r LEFT JOIN domain d ON d.domain = r.key WHERE r.score >= 0.5 AND r.first_flagged_at >= (SELECT MAX(released_at) - INTERVAL 3 DAY FROM rel_domain.release_history) ORDER BY r.first_flagged_at DESC LIMIT 30

panels.title: Recently Flagged Domains (last 3d)

panels.description: Domains with highest spam traffic (live)

targets.queryText: SELECT domain, traffic, spam_traffic, ROUND(traffic_spam_ratio, 3) AS traffic_spam_ratio, CAST(category AS VARCHAR) AS category, reachability, ROUND(header_mailfrom_ratio, 2) AS hdr_mf_ratio, ROUND(days_since_registration, 1) AS days_since_registration FROM domain WHERE traffic_spam_ratio > 0.7 AND traffic >= 50 ORDER BY traffic DESC LIMIT 30

panels.title: High-Traffic Spam Domains (Live)

targets.queryText: SELECT subnet, traffic, spam_traffic, ROUND(traffic_spam_ratio, 3) AS traffic_spam_ratio, ROUND(days_since_first_seen, 1) AS days_since_first_seen FROM subnet WHERE traffic_spam_ratio > 0.7 AND traffic >= 50 ORDER BY traffic DESC LIMIT 30
